name: Advanced CCC
overview: Advanced CCC is a practical computer fundamentals course designed for beginners who want to develop essential computer skills for education, office work, and everyday computer usage.
description: The course provides hands-on training in computer fundamentals, Microsoft Office applications, typing, internet skills, resume preparation, and productivity tools. It is suitable for students, job seekers, office employees, and anyone who wants to become confident in using computers.
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in learning computer fundamentals.
prerequisites: No prior computer knowledge is officially required.

fees.note: Please contact the academy for the latest fee details.

teaching_methodology: Personalized teaching approach with individual attention and practical learning.
study_material: Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.
faculty: Highly qualified, experienced, patient, and supportive faculty members.
learning_outcomes: Create professional documents using Microsoft Word
Improve productivity using computer shortcut keys
Develop essential digital skills for education and office work
career_benefits: Useful computer skills for education and employment

faqs.question: Who can join the Advanced CCC course?
faqs.answer: Anyone interested in learning computer fundamentals, including students, beginners, job seekers, and working professionals.

faqs.question: Do I need prior computer knowledge?
faqs.answer: No. No prior computer knowledge is officially required.

faqs.question: Will I learn Microsoft Office?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course includes Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft PowerPoint.

faqs.question: Does the course include typing practice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both English and Gujarati typing are included.

faqs.question: Will I learn resume making?
faqs.answer: Yes. Resume making and mailing format are covered.

faqs.question: Does the course include internet training?
Is practical training provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course emphasizes practical learning and hands-on computer usage.

faqs.question: Do you provide study material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.

faqs.question: Are flexible batch timings available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flexible batch timings are available.

faqs.question: How can I know the course duration and fees?
faqs.answer: The duration and fees vary depending on the course. Please contact the academy for the latest details.
